chapters.title: Chapter 1551: Fury Burns The Heart - 5!
paragraphs: "Miss, there is no need to waste words on someone like him," the old man said in a composed tone, his voice carrying an unquestionable authority. "He has already fallen to the corrupted side of a devil’s transformation. There have always been humans who trade their souls to devils in exchange for power like this, and every one of them is a traitor to the human race. Such people are to be killed on sight."

"But how did he even come into contact with a devil?" the young woman asked, her brows knitting slightly as confusion surfaced in her eyes. "From what I have heard, the devils of the Devil Realm were wiped out long ago by the Primordials along with the top forces, including our Sword God Palace."

"Miss, that is something I cannot say with certainty," the old man replied as he shook his head, his expression calm yet thoughtful. "However, I am certain of one thing. A transformation like this only occurs when a human willingly sells their soul to a devil in exchange for power. If we capture him and interrogate him, we may be able to uncover the location of the devil he formed a contract with."
"Then do it," the young woman said without hesitation, her voice carrying a decisive coldness.
Max heard every word clearly. They had made no effort to conceal their conversation, and the same words echoed across the battlefield for everyone present to hear.

"Damn it," Max muttered as his brows furrowed. The moment he realized they were from the Sword God Palace, a heavy weight settled in his chest. He knew exactly how powerful such a force was in the Divine Realm, and with their arrival, his chances of killing the young elf master had dropped drastically.

As Max was still weighing his next move, a sudden surge of danger erupted from his right side. Through the perception of his Dimensional Sovereign Body, he instantly detected the old man closing in on him with terrifying speed, his sword already poised and aimed directly at Max’s neck.

Max’s expression turned cold. A fierce struggle flashed within his eyes as he considered unleashing all of his abilities to defend himself, yet he quickly suppressed the impulse. If he revealed too much, there was a real possibility that they would connect him to the devil from Orion, especially if his abilities overlapped in any noticeable way.
Realizing this, Max made a split-second decision and summoned his wings, pulling them tightly around his body to form a protective barrier.
Bang!

The sword struck against the wings with overwhelming force, and the impact blasted Max away like a broken projectile. His body tore through the air as he was thrown out of the hexagonal barrier’s range, crashing far into the distance.

The moment Max’s body came to a halt after crashing into the distance, his figure suddenly blurred and transformed into a streak of red light as he shot back toward the battlefield with explosive speed. His return was so abrupt and so fast that no one had time to react, and none of them had expected him to rise again after taking such a devastating strike.

Because of that brief moment of shock, one of the elven guards was caught completely off guard. Just as he had done before, Max closed the distance in an instant and drove his hand straight through the elf’s chest, tearing through his heart without hesitation.
"HOW DARE YOU!" the elder elf roared in fury as ten radiant golden swords formed around him, each one humming with lethal power before they shot toward Max like streaks of divine judgment.

Max paid no attention to the incoming swords. His focus remained locked on the young master as he pushed forward without slowing down, his intent clear and unwavering. The three elves guarding the young master immediately tensed, their vigilance rising as they prepared to intercept him.
Yet before Max could even get close, a powerful fist emerged from nowhere and slammed directly into him with overwhelming force.
Bang!
His body was blasted away once again, thrown far beyond the hexagonal barrier as he crashed heavily into the distance.

This time, the damage was far more severe. The attack had come without warning, and Max had not even sensed it before it struck him. Caught completely off guard, he had taken the blow head on without any form of defense, and the impact left him seriously injured.
As he wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, Max lifted his gaze toward the direction of the attack, only to see another group had arrived on the battlefield.
"He survived my attack?" the attacker said in clear surprise, his tone laced with disbelief. The people standing behind him also showed visible shock at the sight.

The one who had struck Max was a middle aged man with a powerful build, his presence exuding strength and authority. They were from the War God Palace, having just arrived at Orion after sensing the disturbance that had unfolded here.

"Luke, do not underestimate this creature," the old man from the Sword God Palace said in a steady voice. "He is a human who has undergone a devil transformation, and his strength rivals that of warriors at the peak of the Law Manifestation Realm."

"You do not need to remind me, Old Man Ray," Luke replied as his eyes remained fixed on Max, his gaze sharp and filled with hostility. "I can tell at a glance that this is a devil through and through."

Max’s gaze swept across the newly arrived group from the War God Palace before shifting toward the old man from the Sword God Palace, and in that moment, a heavy realization settled within him as he understood just how dire his situation had become.
A bitter thought surfaced in his mind as he let out a quiet sigh. ’Am I truly not fated to reclaim my bloodline today?’

The anger within him still burned fiercely, and the hatred he carried for what the elves had done to him and his family had not diminished in the slightest, yet even as those emotions surged through him, he could clearly see the reality before his eyes.

With his current strength, he was still far from being able to stand against them. Even now, when he had come closer than ever to his goal, when he had a rare opportunity to kill the young elf and extract the bloodline source, the distance between them still felt insurmountable.

’Was all of this for nothing?’ The thought gnawed at him, filling him with unwillingness to retreat empty handed. Although killing two elves at the Law Manifestation Realm was no small feat, he knew it would hardly cause any meaningful damage to their forces.

"We should capture him and interrogate him to uncover which devil he made a contract with, and once we find that devil, we will eliminate it as well," the old man Ray said as he turned to Luke, his tone calm but firm.

"If that is your decision," Luke replied, and as he spoke, a radiant light began to gather around his body. Within moments, a blazing golden sun manifested behind him, illuminating the surroundings with an overwhelming aura of power.
Seeing this, Max immediately grew alert, and the thought of retreating began to form in his mind as he realized that staying here any longer would only lead to his death.
BOOM!
However, just as that thought crossed his mind, the crack within the hexagonal barrier suddenly burst open, and a pillar of blue light shot straight into the sky with terrifying force.
WHOOM!
In an instant, the blue radiance expanded outward, engulfing the entire planet Orion along with everyone present on it.

When the light faded, Max found himself standing in a desolate land. He instinctively looked around and noticed that the ground was littered with countless corpses, creating a grim and silent scene. The people from the Sword God Palace, the War God Palace, and all the others had vanished without a trace, leaving him completely alone in this unfamiliar place.

"What just happened?" Max muttered in confusion as his body began to revert, the demonic transformation fading away as he returned to his original form. Slowly, he removed the mask from his face and put it away, his expression turning solemn as he tried to comprehend the sudden turn of events.

chapters.title: Chapter 1552: Dimensional Assimilation!
paragraphs: Max extended his Dimensional Sovereign Body outward, allowing his perception to spread across the surroundings, yet no matter how far it reached, all he could sense was ruin.
The land was barren and lifeless, and corpses lay scattered everywhere, stretching endlessly across his field of vision.

"Where am I?" He wondered, his brows tightening slightly. Just a moment ago, he had been facing the forces of the War God Palace and the Sword God Palace, and in the very next instant, he had been thrown into this strange and desolate world.
With no clear understanding of his situation, Max chose not to remain still. He picked a random direction and began to walk, his senses remaining alert as he moved through the silent wasteland.

However, the farther he went, the more bodies he encountered, until a realization slowly began to take shape in his mind. The corpses scattered across the ground seemed to belong to only two distinct races.
One was clearly human, but the other was far more unsettling, as their appearance resembled demons while still feeling subtly different.
"Devils?" Max muttered, his eyes turning cold as he reached this unsettling conclusion.

"If these demon-like corpses are devils, then could the human-like ones actually be primordials?" he speculated, his thoughts deepening as he examined the scene more carefully. He knew that humans and primordials shared an almost identical appearance, which made it difficult to distinguish between them with certainty.
After a moment of contemplation, Max spoke again in a low voice. "The corpses here belong to devils, humans, and primordials."
This realization only deepened his confusion, as he began to question where such a place could exist. A battlefield containing all three races was not something one would encounter casually.
It was then that a memory surfaced in his mind. Orion had once been the central battlefield of a devastating war between the primordials and the devils.

"Could this be some kind of secret domain within Orion?" Max wondered, his gaze sharpening. It was the most plausible explanation he could think of at the moment. The presence of these three races aligned perfectly with the history of that ancient war, and Orion was the only place nearby that matched such a description.
Yet even as the thought formed, doubt lingered.
"Only a secret domain could preserve a battlefield in such a state," Max murmured as he looked at the corpses around him.

From their condition, they appeared as though they had died only a day ago. If this had been anywhere else on Orion, the passage of time and the chaotic energies of the world would have long since reduced these bodies to dust, or transformed them into treasures, or even triggered some strange and unpredictable phenomenon.
The unnatural freshness of the corpses made one thing clear to him.
This place was not ordinary and could be inside a secret domain of some sort which explained how the freshness of the corpse had been maintained.
Understanding this, Max slowly closed his eyes and activated one of his abilities, focusing his mind as he reached out toward the strange world around him.
"Dimensional Assimilation," he muttered under his breath.
Almost instantly, a series of notifications echoed within his mind.
[Dimensional Assimilation has been activated.]
[Searching for a Dimension to assimilate...]
[Dimension detected... Initiating assimilation... Assimilation successful!]
[Congratulations to Max Voidwalker for assimilating a dimension for the first time.]

"It worked!" Max exclaimed, a surge of excitement rising within him as he nearly leaped in place. He had been uncertain whether this ability would function within this mysterious secret domain, but it turned out that his worries had been unnecessary.

At that moment, he felt a faint yet undeniable connection form between himself and the world around him. It resembled the bond he shared with his other dimensions, yet there was something incomplete about it, as if the connection lacked a certain purity.
[Please name the dimension.]
"A name..." Max murmured as he fell into brief contemplation before arriving at a decision. "Since this secret domain exists within Orion, I will call it the Orion Battlefield."
[Orion Battlefield]
– Type: [Temporary Dimension, Temporal Dimension]
– Cultivation Restriction: [None]
– Total Number Restriction: [None]
– Race Restriction: [None]
– Ban Column: [None]

As Max observed the status of the newly assimilated domain, his blood began to surge with excitement. He had never expected that assimilating this secret domain would grant him such a level of control over it.
In the dimensions he had naturally unlocked before, he existed as an almost omnipotent presence, capable of shaping and controlling everything at will.

However, this dimension was different, as it had been assimilated from the outside. Because of that, the system had provided him with a structured interface, allowing him to manage and govern every aspect of this world with precision.

After calming himself, Max focused his attention and began to carefully examine the status of the newly assimilated dimension, his expression turning thoughtful as he tried to understand every detail presented before him.

"A Temporary Dimension and a Temporal Dimension?" he murmured, narrowing his eyes slightly. The meaning of a Temporary Dimension was clear to him, yet the concept of a Temporal Dimension was far more obscure, and he could not fully grasp its implications at first glance.

– Temporary Dimension: [Orion Battlefield is not a permanent possession of Max Voidwalker. Its existence and ownership are unstable, meaning that it may change, shift, or even be lost depending on the evolving conditions within the dimension itself.]

Max nodded slowly as he read through the explanation. This meant that although he had successfully assimilated the domain, his control over it was not absolute or guaranteed to last forever. The dimension was bound to certain unknown variables, and if those variables changed, his hold over it could weaken or disappear entirely.
His gaze then shifted to the next description, his curiosity deepening.

– Temporal Dimension: [Orion Battlefield is a dimension permeated with a powerful temporal aura. Everything within it, including the land, the corpses, and all other existences, originates from a specific point in time, preserved or recreated as it once was.]

Max’s expression grew serious as understanding slowly dawned upon him. This was not merely a battlefield left behind after a war. It was a fragment of time itself, a space where a certain era had been captured and sealed within the dimension.
The corpses he had seen were not simply remnants of the past, but rather echoes of a specific moment, existing as they were at that point in time.
In other words, this dimension was not just a place.
It was a preserved timeline.

chapters.title: Chapter 1553: Orion Battlefield!
paragraphs: "It seems this battlefield belongs to the same time when the war between the devils and the primordials took place on Orion," Max murmured as he slowly pieced together his thoughts, his gaze sweeping across the desolate land filled with silent remnants of that ancient conflict.
As the idea settled in his mind, another question immediately followed. "If that is the case, then could this secret domain have been created by some kind of accident?"

He found it difficult to imagine any deliberate method that could produce a domain like this. The existence of such a place felt too chaotic, too unrefined, as though it had been formed by forces colliding rather than by careful design.

His thoughts quickly returned to what had happened earlier. A crack in the void had appeared within Orion, a rift that strangely connected to the Mortal Realm, and before anyone could fully understand its nature, that very crack had erupted, giving birth to this domain that now mirrored an ancient battlefield.
Max frowned slightly as he tried to connect these events, yet no matter how he arranged the pieces, the logic behind it remained unclear.

Was the crack merely a passage, or had it been a trigger? Could the energies from the Mortal Realm have interacted with the lingering remnants of the war on Orion, causing this dimension to take shape?
Or perhaps the battlefield itself had never truly disappeared, only lying dormant within the fabric of space and time until something disturbed it.

Another possibility crossed his mind, one that made his expression turn more serious. What if this was not an accident at all? What if this battlefield had been sealed intentionally, preserved within time for reasons unknown, and the crack had simply broken that seal?
Max let out a slow breath as he looked at the barren horizon once more. No matter which possibility was true, one thing had become certain in his mind.
Orion was far more than it appeared on the surface.
There were secrets buried within this planet that no one had fully uncovered, and he had just stumbled upon one of them.

Shaking his head, Max pushed aside the swirling thoughts and redirected his focus toward the remaining details displayed in the status of the secret domain, his expression gradually turning calm as he began to examine everything with greater care.
[Orion Battlefield]
– Type: [Temporary Dimension, Temporal Dimension]
– Cultivation Restriction: [None]
– Total Number Restriction: [None]
– Race Restriction: [None]
– Ban Column: [None]

Max studied each line slowly, his eyes narrowing slightly as he processed the meaning behind them. "Cultivation Restriction, Total Number Restriction, Race Restriction, and Ban Column," he murmured under his breath, already forming a rough understanding of their purpose.
When his attention settled on the Cultivation Restriction, the interface responded immediately, and a series of options unfolded before him as though awaiting his command.
[Divine King Realm, Divine Lord Realm, Law Manifestation Realm, Law Refinement Realm]

"Only up to the Law Refinement Realm?" Max frowned, a hint of dissatisfaction surfacing in his expression. He had initially believed that assimilating this dimension would grant him complete authority over every aspect within it, including the ability to freely dictate the limits of cultivation, but the system clearly imposed its own boundaries.
After a brief moment of consideration, Max made his decision. He chose to restrict the cultivation of all beings within this dimension to the peak of the Law Refinement Realm.

Although he would have preferred to suppress it even further to the Law Awakening Realm to ensure absolute control, the system did not allow him to set a lower threshold, leaving him with no better option.

Once that was done, his focus shifted toward the Total Number Restriction and Race Restriction. This time, he did not make any changes. If he wished to uncover the secrets hidden within this battlefield, especially those tied to the war between the Primordials and the Devils, then he needed the dimension to unfold as naturally as possible, just as it had in its original timeline.
Any interference in the number of participants or the races present could distort the sequence of events and lead him away from the truth.
Finally, his gaze rested on the Ban Column, and a thoughtful look appeared in his eyes. He could sense that this feature held a more direct and forceful authority.

If his understanding was correct, he should be able to target individuals who did not originally belong to this dimension, such as himself, Lucia, Isabella, or anyone else who had entered through external means, and remove them from this space with nothing more than a single thought.
That realization caused a faint spark of anticipation to rise within him. However, he quickly restrained himself, knowing that this was still only a theory.
He would need to test it.
Only then would he truly understand the extent of his control over this world.

After carefully reviewing every aspect of the dimension’s status once more and confirming that nothing had been overlooked, Max dismissed the interface and shifted his attention back to his surroundings.

Now that this dimension had become a part of him, his connection to it had deepened significantly. Through his Dimensional Sovereign Body, his perception expanded across the entire space, allowing him to observe nearly everything within it as though it were an extension of his own senses.
It was like how he could perceive everything in his other dimensions but as a much limited version.
Focusing his thoughts, Max searched for familiar presences, and almost instantly, he located both Lucia and Isabella within the vast expanse of the battlefield.

"Isabella is with a small group, while Lucia is on her own," Max murmured, his brows tightening slightly as he analyzed their positions. "But Lucia is moving north, and if she continues on that path, she will run directly into Raymond from that second rate force."

After quickly assessing the situation, Max made his decision without hesitation. He turned in the direction where Isabella was located, knowing that she and Lucia were positioned along a similar path, and began moving toward her first.

The existence of such a place felt too chaotic, too unrefined, as though it had been formed by forces colliding rather than by careful design.
His thoughts quickly returned to what had happened earlier.

A crack in the void had appeared within Orion, a rift that strangely connected to the Mortal Realm, and before anyone could fully understand its nature, that very crack had erupted, giving birth to this domain that now mirrored an ancient battlefield.
Max frowned slightly as he tried to connect these events, yet no matter how he arranged the pieces, the logic behind it remained unclear.
Was the crack merely a passage, or had it been a trigger?
Could the energies from the Mortal Realm have interacted with the lingering remnants of the war on Orion, causing this dimension to take shape?
Or perhaps the battlefield itself had never truly disappeared, only lying dormant within the fabric of space and time until something disturbed it.
Another possibility crossed his mind, one that made his expression turn more serious.
What if this was not an accident at all?
What if this battlefield had been sealed intentionally, preserved within time for reasons unknown, and the crack had simply broken that seal?
Max let out a slow breath as he looked at the barren horizon once more.
No matter which possibility was true, one thing had become certain in his mind.
Orion was far more than it appeared on the surface.
There were secrets buried within this planet that no one had fully uncovered, and he had just stumbled upon one of them.

Shaking his head, Max pushed aside the swirling thoughts and redirected his focus toward the remaining details displayed in the status of the secret domain, his expression gradually turning calm as he began to examine everything with greater care.
[Orion Battlefield]
– Type: [Temporary Dimension, Temporal Dimension]
– Cultivation Restriction: [None]
– Total Number Restriction: [None]
– Race Restriction: [None]
– Ban Column: [None]
Max studied each line slowly, his eyes narrowing slightly as he processed the meaning behind them.
"Cultivation Restriction, Total Number Restriction, Race Restriction, and Ban Column," he murmured under his breath, already forming a rough understanding of their purpose.
When his attention settled on the Cultivation Restriction, the interface responded immediately, and a series of options unfolded before him as though awaiting his command.
[Divine King Realm, Divine Lord Realm, Law Manifestation Realm, Law Refinement Realm]
"Only up to the Law Refinement Realm?" Max frowned, a hint of dissatisfaction surfacing in his expression.

He had initially believed that assimilating this dimension would grant him complete authority over every aspect within it, including the ability to freely dictate the limits of cultivation, but the system clearly imposed its own boundaries.
After a brief moment of consideration, Max made his decision.
He chose to restrict the cultivation of all beings within this dimension to the peak of the Law Refinement Realm.

Although he would have preferred to suppress it even further to the Law Awakening Realm to ensure absolute control, the system did not allow him to set a lower threshold, leaving him with no better option.
Once that was done, his focus shifted toward the Total Number Restriction and Race Restriction.
This time, he did not make any changes.

If he wished to uncover the secrets hidden within this battlefield, especially those tied to the war between the Primordials and the Devils, then he needed the dimension to unfold as naturally as possible, just as it had in its original timeline.
Any interference in the number of participants or the races present could distort the sequence of events and lead him away from the truth.
Finally, his gaze rested on the Ban Column, and a thoughtful look appeared in his eyes.
He could sense that this feature held a more direct and forceful authority.

If his understanding was correct, he should be able to target individuals who did not originally belong to this dimension, such as himself, Lucia, Isabella, or anyone else who had entered through external means, and remove them from this space with nothing more than a single thought.
That realization caused a faint spark of anticipation to rise within him.
However, he quickly restrained himself, knowing that this was still only a theory.
He would need to test it.
Only then would he truly understand the extent of his control over this world.

After carefully reviewing every aspect of the dimension’s status once more and confirming that nothing had been overlooked, Max dismissed the interface and shifted his attention back to his surroundings.
Now that this dimension had become a part of him, his connection to it had deepened significantly.
Through his Dimensional Sovereign Body, his perception expanded across the entire space, allowing him to observe nearly everything within it as though it were an extension of his own senses.
It was like how he could perceive everything in his other dimensions but as a much limited version.
Focusing his thoughts, Max searched for familiar presences, and almost instantly, he located both Lucia and Isabella within the vast expanse of the battlefield.
"Isabella is with a small group, while Lucia is on her own," Max murmured, his brows tightening slightly as he analyzed their positions.
"But Lucia is moving north, and if she continues on that path, she will run directly into Raymond from that second rate force."
After quickly assessing the situation, Max made his decision without hesitation.
He turned in the direction where Isabella was located, knowing that she and Lucia were positioned along a similar path, and began moving toward her first.

chapters.title: Chapter 1554: Strange Creatures!
paragraphs: Max kept his Dimensional Sovereign Body fully active as he sprinted across the desolate land, his figure cutting through the barren battlefield with unwavering speed as he moved toward Isabella’s location.

The closer he drew, the more his earlier assumptions were confirmed. This place truly was a battlefield from the past. Scattered across the land were the wreckage of star shuttles of all sizes, their broken hulls half buried in the earth, while countless corpses lay strewn around them, belonging to humans, primordials, and devils alike.
The entire scene carried an oppressive stillness, as though time itself had been frozen at the moment of destruction.
Yet before he could advance much further, Max suddenly came to an abrupt halt.
Figures had appeared ahead of him.
No, not just ahead. They emerged from all directions, surrounding him completely in an instant.

Max’s eyes narrowed as he observed the creatures that had encircled him, a deep frown forming on his face as unease crept into his mind. "I cannot see them... nor can I sense them through my Dimensional Sovereign Body. Why is that?" he muttered quietly.

His ability should have allowed him to perceive nearly everything within this dimension, especially now that he had assimilated it, yet these creatures had appeared without any prior warning. It was as if they had slipped past his perception entirely, as though his Dimensional Sovereign Body simply could not recognize their existence.
For a brief moment, a chilling thought crossed his mind. Was it that his ability was being suppressed, or were these creatures existing outside the rules of the dimension itself?
Max pushed the thought aside for the time being and focused his attention on the creatures surrounding him.
They were unlike anything he had ever seen.

Their bodies were pitch black, absorbing even the faintest traces of light, and each of them stood on six thick, jointed legs that dug into the ground with unsettling stability. Yet they were not spiders.

Their upper bodies were grotesquely shaped, resembling a twisted fusion of beast and nightmare. Where a head should have been, there was a massive wolf-like maw that stretched unnaturally wide, lined with rows of jagged, uneven teeth that seemed to shift and grind against one another even when the creature remained still.

Their size alone was enough to instill dread, as each of them towered over him, their massive forms rivaling and even surpassing the bulk of an elephant. Their skin appeared slick and unnatural, as though it were made from a dark, pulsating substance rather than flesh, and faint distortions rippled across their bodies, making it difficult to focus on their exact shape.
From within those gaping maws came a low, guttural sound, something between a growl and a distant echo, as if their voices did not belong entirely to this world.
As they slowly closed in around him, the air itself seemed to grow heavier, and for the first time since arriving in this domain, Max felt a faint sense of unease settle deep within his heart.
"What are these beasts?" Max wondered, but the question barely had time to form before the creatures moved.
They lunged at him all at once.

Their massive bodies surged forward with terrifying speed, their six legs pounding against the ground as their grotesque wolf-like jaws opened wide, revealing rows of twisted, grinding teeth that seemed to hunger for flesh. A foul, suffocating aura spread from them as they closed in, as though they intended to tear him apart in a single instant.
Max’s eyes turned cold.

In the next moment, his body ignited with black flames, and from those flames, countless swords took shape, each one burning with a dark and violent energy. The air trembled as the black flaming swords shot outward in all directions.
The instant the creatures reached him, the swords struck.
One after another, the monstrous beings were pinned to the ground, their massive bodies pierced and immobilized before they could even react.
Then—
Boom! Boom! Boom!

Explosions erupted one after another, shaking the battlefield as the black flaming swords detonated violently. Each blast tore through the creatures’ bodies, reducing their grotesque forms to shattered remains engulfed in black fire.
This destructive effect came from the inheritance technique known as Black Flames Explosive Burst, a power that allowed anything formed from his black flames to detonate with devastating force.
As the smoke and dust gradually settled, silence returned to the battlefield.
Every single one of the creatures had been annihilated.
Although their numbers had been significant, their strength had only reached the Law Awakening Realm, which posed no real threat to the current Max.
"Devour," Max said calmly as he looked at the burning remains.
The black flames intensified, swallowing the corpses completely, and within moments, not a single trace of those creatures remained.
Almost immediately, Max felt something change within his body.
A strange and unfamiliar power stirred deep inside him.

He closed his eyes and focused inward, carefully observing the shift. That strange energy did not remain separate for long, as it was quickly drawn toward the Infernal Energy within him, merging with it and strengthening it in a noticeable way.
Max’s eyes snapped open.
"Devouring these creatures can actually enhance my Infernal Energy?" he muttered in shock.
This was something he had never experienced before.

The Infernal Energy within him originated from the Infernal Demon Tattoo, a power given to him by Mark, who himself had been corrupted by the True Origin Devil Blood. Until now, that energy had remained constant, with no known method to directly increase or refine it.
Yet these creatures had changed that.
By devouring them, his Infernal Energy had grown stronger.
Max’s expression slowly turned serious as a new thought emerged in his mind.
What exactly were these creatures?

"These creatures are connected to the devils," Max concluded, his eyes narrowing as his thoughts began to deepen. A more daring idea quickly followed. "If that is the case, then does it mean I can also increase the Infernal Energy within my body by devouring the devil corpses scattered across this battlefield?"

Although Max held a deep aversion toward the Infernal Energy within him, he could not deny that it had become a core part of his strength. Now that he had discovered a method to enhance it by devouring beings tied to devils, a spark of excitement rose within him despite his reservations.

chapters.title: Chapter 1555: Devouring True Origin Devil Blood?
paragraphs: "That reminds me," Max murmured as his thoughts shifted, his expression growing more contemplative. "I still have that drop of True Origin Devil Blood sealed within the Dimension of Time. In one way or another, both my Infernal Energy and my Infernal Demon Transformation originated from that very drop. It is the true source of everything related to this power. If that is the case... could I devour it to drastically increase my strength?"
The moment that thought surfaced, Max immediately shook his head, forcing himself to reject it.

He clearly remembered what had happened to Mark, the crownbearer of Acaris. Even with divine power flowing through him, Mark had still been corrupted after coming into contact with the True Origin Devil Blood, losing control and becoming a puppet of its malevolent will.

Max’s expression turned serious as he considered his own state. The hatred burning within his heart was far from stable, and if he were to attempt something so reckless, the consequences would likely be far worse.
"I would most likely lose myself completely and descend into madness if I tried to devour that drop of blood right now," Max muttered, his voice low.

After a moment of silence, he spoke again, his tone steady but resolute. "Only when my strength reaches a level where I can stand on equal footing with the power contained in that drop can I even consider such a thing."
Max understood his limits clearly. His current strength was nowhere near enough to withstand or control the overwhelming force within that blood, and attempting it now would only lead to disaster.
Even so, a faint certainty lingered in his mind.
There would come a day when he would have no choice but to face it.

"There are far too many devil corpses scattered across this battlefield," Max muttered, a faint smile forming on his lips as a new resolve settled within him. "If I devour them, my Infernal Energy will continue to grow."

With that thought, he began moving again, his figure cutting across the desolate land as his black flames flickered faintly around him. Wherever he went, the flames followed, sweeping across the ground like a silent tide.
It did not take long before he encountered the first cluster of corpses.

Dozens of devil bodies lay piled together, their forms twisted and lifeless, yet still carrying traces of the dark energy they once possessed. Without hesitation, Max released his black flames, allowing them to engulf the corpses completely. In a matter of moments, the bodies were reduced to nothing, their essence drawn into him as nourishment for his Infernal Energy.
He did not stop there.

As he continued forward, more and more corpses appeared along his path. Devils, primordials, and humans alike were devoured without distinction. The battlefield itself became a source of power for him, and he showed no hesitation in consuming everything that could strengthen him.

With each wave of devouring, Max felt the changes within his body becoming more pronounced. The power that had been stabilized at the peak of the Rebirth Realm began to loosen, as though a barrier was slowly cracking. A faint but undeniable pull toward the first level of the Law Awakening Realm began to emerge.
A spark of excitement flashed in his eyes.
Without slowing down, Max increased his pace, devouring every corpse that came into his sight as he continued moving toward Isabella’s location.
However, as he advanced deeper into the battlefield, he once again encountered those horrifying creatures.

They appeared just as suddenly as before, surrounding him without any prior warning, their grotesque forms closing in with the same predatory intent. Their presence was still completely absent from his Dimensional Sovereign Body, as though they did not exist within his perception at all.
Max’s expression turned serious.
Despite his control over this dimension, these creatures continued to bypass his awareness entirely, which made their existence even more unsettling.
Yet this time, he did not hesitate.

Black flames erupted once more, forming countless swords that pierced through the creatures the moment they lunged at him. Explosions followed instantly, tearing their massive bodies apart and reducing them to nothing but burning remnants.
Then, just as before, he devoured them.
The strange energy within their bodies once again flowed into him, merging with his Infernal Energy and strengthening it further.
As Max continued onward, a new realization began to form in his mind.
It was not just those creatures that his Dimensional Sovereign Body could not perceive.
Even the countless corpses scattered across the battlefield had never appeared within his perception.
He slowed slightly, his brows tightening as he connected the pieces together.

"So that is how it is," Max muttered quietly. "My Dimensional Sovereign Body can only perceive those who belong to my timeline within this dimension. Everything that exists here from the past timeline is completely invisible to it."
That realization made his expression turn more solemn, yet it also helped him understand the limitations of his control over this place.
Even so, he did not stop.
He continued to move forward, devouring everything in his path, growing stronger with every step as the battlefield itself became his resource.
After some time, the desolate landscape began to shift, and figures finally appeared within his perception once again.
Max’s eyes sharpened.
"This is the group Isabella is in."
However, the moment Max took a closer look, his expression turned solemn.

Hundreds of those same horrifying creatures that had attacked him earlier had now surrounded Isabella’s group, forming a tightening circle that left almost no room to escape. Their massive, grotesque bodies pressed in from all sides, their distorted maws opening and closing as low, chilling growls echoed across the battlefield.

Isabella’s group consisted of several individuals at the Law Awakening Realm along with a few at the Law Refinement Realm, yet even with such strength, they were clearly struggling to hold their ground.

Not everyone possessed the ability to deal with these creatures effectively. While some members managed to resist and push them back with difficulty, others were completely overwhelmed by the sheer ferocity and unnatural resilience of the beasts.

Isabella herself was among those who found it difficult to fight them. Her attacks failed to produce any meaningful effect, leaving her in a vulnerable position as the creatures continued to close in.
The imbalance in numbers only made the situation worse.

There were barely nine people in her group, yet they were facing an overwhelming swarm of hundreds. The battlefield around them had turned into a desperate struggle for survival, and with each passing moment, their position grew more precarious.
Max’s gaze hardened as he took in the scene.
Their situation had already reached a critical point.

chapters.title: Chapter 1556: Luna from War God Palace!
paragraphs: "They are in danger," Max muttered as his gaze sharpened, taking in the sight of Isabella’s group being completely surrounded by those grotesque creatures.

Without hesitation, he pushed his speed to its limit and closed the distance in an instant, his figure tearing across the battlefield like a streak of light. The moment he arrived within range, black flames erupted from his body, surging outward with violent intensity as he shaped them with a single thought.

In the next moment, the flames condensed into countless swords, each one burning with a dark and oppressive aura. Within seconds, hundreds of black flaming swords hovered in the air above him, filling the sky with a terrifying presence.
Max did not waste even a heartbeat.
With a single command, the swords shot forward.

In an instant, the sky above Isabella’s group was covered by a storm of black flames as the swords descended like a relentless rain. Each one moved with precise intent, targeting the creatures below without the slightest deviation.
Whish! Whish! Whish!
The swords fell in overwhelming numbers, streaking through the air as they struck the creatures one after another, piercing through their massive bodies and pinning them firmly to the ground.
The sheer volume of the attack was so immense that even Isabella and the others felt a surge of alarm as they looked up, fearing that the rain of blades might strike them as well.
Yet not a single sword touched them.
Every strike landed perfectly.
Within moments, the battlefield was filled with the sight of black flaming swords embedded deep within the creatures, their bodies immobilized and engulfed in dark flames.
The sudden turn of events left Isabella’s group stunned.

Just moments ago, they had been struggling desperately to hold back the relentless swarm, barely managing to survive under the overwhelming pressure. Now, in the blink of an eye, a large number of those same creatures had been subdued and killed with terrifying efficiency.
Shock spread across their faces as they tried to comprehend what had just happened.
"Isabella, are you alright?" Max called out as he stepped forward, his gaze fixed on her the moment he arrived before the group.

Isabella nodded, a trace of relief appearing on her face as the tension in her body eased. "Thank you for saving us," she said sincerely. The moment she had seen the rain of black flaming swords descending upon the creatures, she had already guessed who it might be. Among everyone present on Orion, only Max and Lucia possessed such distinct black flames apart from herself.
"Isabella, who is he?" a woman with long blue hair asked, her voice carrying both authority and confusion. Her eyes shimmered like distant stars as she looked at Max with a sharp, assessing gaze.

"Miss Luna, this is..." Isabella began, but her words faltered midway as a thought crossed her mind. She hesitated, recalling Max’s well known identity and wondering whether revealing his name in front of everyone was the right choice.
She turned toward Max, seeking his approval, and saw him give a small nod.
Understanding his intent, Isabella spoke without further hesitation. "He is Max, a fellow disciple of my Black Dragon Clan. He is the one who saved us just now."
"He is Max?" Luna exclaimed, her expression shifting to one of clear shock as she looked at him again. "Max Morgan, the one who took the sword of the Sword Sovereign?"

From the outside, Max appeared no different from a cultivator at the peak of the Rebirth Realm, someone who should not have stood out among the strong. Yet the memory of those black flaming swords effortlessly pinning down the devil creatures was still vivid in her mind. It made her realize that his displayed cultivation was nothing more than a surface illusion, and that his true strength lay far beyond what his realm suggested.

Max responded with a faint smile as he saw that Luna had recognized him. He had made a deliberate choice not to wear the black dragon mask that Lucia had once given him, and there was a clear reason behind it.

Luna offered a faint smile but did not press further.

chapters.title: Chapter 1557: About to level up?
paragraphs: "I do not know for certain," Luna replied, shaking her head slightly. "Everything happened too quickly. One moment we were still on Orion, and the next moment we found ourselves here. However, I did notice something unusual. When I first arrived, my strength was at the fifth level of the Law Manifestation Realm, but shortly after, it was forcefully suppressed to the peak of the Law Refinement Realm."

She paused briefly before continuing. "I also encountered some of these creatures earlier when they were at the Law Manifestation Realm, but after my strength was suppressed, I have not seen any of them at that level again."

Her expression turned more serious as she voiced her conclusion. "My guess is that we have been pulled into some kind of secret domain within Orion. If that assumption is correct, then the cause may be related to the battle between that masked man and the elven group. Their clash likely destabilized the crack in the void, causing it to expand and draw all of us inside."

After a brief moment of thought, she added, "As for this domain itself, it appears to be restricted to the peak of the Law Refinement Realm. Otherwise, there would be no reason for my cultivation to be forcibly suppressed to that level."
Max nodded slightly as he listened, silently understanding how the restrictions within this dimension were taking effect and aligning with what he had already observed.

"From what I can tell, the center of this secret domain is where the most dangerous auras are gathering," Max said, his expression turning serious as he spoke. "If my judgment is correct, then that is also where we are most likely to find a way out."
"The center of the secret domain?" Luna frowned as she looked at him closely. "That is strange. I cannot sense anything in that direction. How are you able to detect it?"
Max gave a slight shrug, his tone calm and indifferent. "Whether you believe me or not is your choice. If you do not, then I will simply take Isabella and leave on my own."

Luna studied him for a moment, her gaze steady and thoughtful as she weighed his words. After a brief silence, she spoke. "I do not have any clear direction to follow at the moment, so I will go along with your lead for now."
A faint smile appeared on Max’s face. "That works."
"Then let us move," Max said as he shifted his attention back to the battlefield.

With a thought, the black flaming swords that had pinned down the devil creatures flared to life once more, their flames intensifying as they began to devour the bodies impaled beneath them. Within moments, both the swords and the corpses were consumed entirely, leaving no trace behind.
Luna and the others did not react with much surprise. To them, it simply appeared as though Max had burned the creatures to nothing.
Soon, the group began moving again, this time heading directly toward the center of the secret domain.
Coincidentally, this direction aligned with the path Lucia was taking. Considering her cautious and measured pace, Max was confident that they would encounter her before long.
As for the dangerous auras he had mentioned, Max knew that part of his statement was an exaggeration meant to guide Luna and her group toward the direction he intended to go.
However, that did not mean the center of this domain was ordinary.

Ever since he had assimilated this dimension, Max had been able to sense a powerful spatial disturbance emanating from that area. It was unlike anything he had ever felt before, vast and unstable, as though space itself was being distorted on an enormous scale.
If his instincts were correct, that disturbance was either the key to escaping this domain, or it concealed something far more significant beyond it.

As the group continued their journey across the desolate battlefield, they soon found that the path ahead was far from safe. Time and time again, those horrifying devilish creatures emerged from the wasteland, appearing without warning and surrounding them with the same relentless hunger.

However, with Max and Luna leading the group, each encounter ended swiftly. Luna’s strength at the peak of the Law Refinement Realm allowed her to hold back and suppress the creatures with precision, while Max’s black flames brought destruction upon them with overwhelming force. Together, they cut through every wave that stood in their way.

Each time the creatures were slain, Max made sure not to leave their corpses behind. His black flames would quietly consume them, drawing out their essence and strengthening the Infernal Energy within him before the group moved forward once again.
Hours passed as they traveled deeper into the domain.
The pattern soon became clear.

Every few hours, as though following some unseen rhythm, new hordes of those creatures would appear. They would emerge from the barren land, from behind ruined structures, or sometimes from nowhere at all, surrounding the group in waves that seemed endless.

The constant battles began to wear on the others. Even though they managed to survive each encounter, the pressure never truly eased. The creatures did not grow weaker, and their numbers did not diminish. If anything, it felt as though they were being drawn deeper into a place where these beings were even more concentrated.

Yet despite the mounting tension, Max continued forward without hesitation, devouring every fallen creature along the way, his strength steadily rising as the group pressed on toward the unknown depths of the secret domain.
As they continued moving forward, Max suddenly halted in his tracks, his expression shifting as a subtle change occurred within him.
"What happened?" Luna asked immediately, her eyes narrowing as she looked at him.
"I think I am about to break through to the Law Awakening Realm," Max said in a low voice, his tone calm but certain.

The moment he spoke, he could clearly feel the accumulated energy within his body reaching a critical point. After devouring so many of those devilish creatures, each of which possessed strength at the Law Awakening Realm or even the Law Refinement Realm, it was only natural that his own cultivation had reached the threshold for advancement.

"You are about to level up?" Luna repeated, her surprise evident. She could not understand how such a sudden breakthrough was possible. From what she had observed, Max had neither absorbed any Divine Crystals nor consumed any rare treasures that would normally support such a leap from the peak of the Rebirth Realm to the first level of the Law Awakening Realm.
"Please keep watch for me while I break through," Max said, turning his gaze toward Luna and Isabella.
Isabella nodded without hesitation, fully trusting him, while Luna’s brows furrowed slightly as she considered the situation.
"Make it quick," Luna said after a moment, her tone serious. "There is no telling what we might encounter next in this place."
Max gave a small nod in response, already preparing himself for the breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 1558: Law Seeds!
paragraphs: Max moved away from the group and chose a spot at a safe distance before sitting down, his expression turning focused as he prepared for the breakthrough.

He clearly understood that the transition from the Rebirth Realm to the Law Awakening Realm was not a simple increase in strength. It was a fundamental transformation. The Law Embryos within his body would evolve into Law Seeds, marking a true step into the comprehension and control of laws. Because of this, he did not want to take even the slightest risk.
It was not that he did not trust Luna or the others. Rather, he simply refused to leave such an important moment to chance.
At the same time, he kept his clone on standby, hidden and ready to act in case anything unexpected occurred.

Once he was certain of his position, Max adjusted himself so that the group, standing at a distance, could not clearly see what he was doing. Only after ensuring that did he reach into his dimensional space.
A corpse appeared before him.
It was the body of a primordial, one that had once stood at the peak of the Law Manifestation Realm. Even in death, it still carried a faint trace of the immense power it once possessed.

During their journey, Max had refrained from openly devouring the corpses of the three races in front of the group, but he had quietly stored several of them within his dimensional space, anticipating that they would prove useful at a crucial moment like this.
"Time to break through," Max murmured.

Black flames erupted from his hand, surging forward and engulfing the corpse entirely. The fire did not burn like ordinary flames. It consumed. It devoured. The primordial body rapidly disintegrated as its essence was drawn into Max’s body, fueling the transformation that was about to begin.
As the energy flooded into him, a powerful surge spread through his entire being.
Inside his body, the changes began.

The Law Embryos that he had painstakingly nurtured started to tremble. Sword, ice, flames, space, lightning, and light. Each of these embryonic forms of law began to resonate with the energy he had just absorbed. They no longer remained in their incomplete, nascent state.
One by one, they began to transform.

The Sword Law Embryo sharpened, condensing into a radiant core that pulsed with a cutting intent capable of severing all things. The Ice Law Embryo crystallized, turning into a seed of absolute cold that seemed to freeze even the surrounding space. The Flame Law Embryo roared to life, compressing into a blazing core that radiated destructive heat.

The Space Law Embryo distorted and folded in on itself, forming a seed that carried the essence of endless depth and distance. Lightning crackled violently as its embryo condensed into a seed of pure speed and destruction. Light gathered and refined, becoming a seed that shone with an almost divine brilliance.
Each transformation was slow yet undeniable.
The embryos shed their incomplete nature and were reborn as true Law Seeds.

As this process continued, Max’s aura began to rise steadily, breaking past the limits of the Rebirth Realm. The power within him surged upward, crossing the boundary he had been pressing against for so long.
The transformation was not just external.
It was a complete evolution of his foundation.
Max sat still amidst the raging energy, his expression calm and unwavering as he guided the process, allowing the power he had devoured to refine and elevate every aspect of his being.
He was stepping into an entirely new realm.

All of the Law Seeds began to revolve steadily around his core within his inner space, their movements forming a harmonious cycle that marked the complete evolution of his Law Embryos. The transformation was clear and undeniable. What had once been incomplete had now reached a higher state, stabilizing into true manifestations of law.
Yet just as Max was certain that he was about to step fully into the first level of the Law Awakening Realm, something unexpected occurred.
A faint ripple passed through his inner space.
"Huh?" Max’s focus sharpened instantly.
Without any warning, new Law Seeds began to appear.
They formed out of nothing.

Max’s eyes widened as he observed the phenomenon unfolding within him. One after another, additional Law Seeds materialized around the ones he had already formed, expanding the structure of his inner space in a way that defied his understanding.
"How is this possible?" he muttered, unable to hide his astonishment.

He knew very well how Law Seeds were created. Each one required a Law Embryo as its foundation, and only after a cultivator nurtured that embryo could it evolve into a Law Seed. That was the natural process, and it was the path he himself had followed to form the seeds of sword, ice, flames, space, lightning, and light.
Yet these new Law Seeds had no such origin.
They were not born from any Law Embryo that had existed within his body during the Rebirth Realm. They simply appeared, as if conjured directly from the void itself.
Max forced himself to calm down and focused his attention on them, carefully observing their nature.
Their numbers continued to grow.
Dozens turned into hundreds, and soon even those counts became meaningless as their presence expanded into the thousands.
However, as he examined them more closely, he noticed something unusual.
These Law Seeds were empty.

They did not contain any elemental affinity, nor did they carry any concept such as sword or spear. They lacked the defining essence that every Law Seed should possess. They were nothing more than pure, blank vessels.
Max’s confusion deepened as he tried to understand their purpose.
Why would such empty Law Seeds form within his body?
After a moment of thought, a realization began to take shape in his mind, and his expression slowly turned serious.
If there was any explanation for this anomaly, then it could only be connected to one thing.
His Dimensional Keeper legacy. Only something as unique as this could have such a strange phenomena in his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1559: Changes in Chaos Tree!
paragraphs: Seeing these newly formed empty Law Seeds, Max could not help but feel puzzled as he tried to understand their purpose.

Under normal circumstances, a Law Seed served as the foundation for comprehending a specific law. It represented the earliest stage of understanding, a starting point from which a cultivator could gradually deepen their grasp over an element or concept.
However, these seeds were different.
They contained nothing.
They carried no element, no concept, no direction.
Max frowned slightly as he observed them. Without any defining essence, how could these empty Law Seeds contribute to his cultivation? How could something without a foundation lead to comprehension?
"I will figure that out later," Max muttered as he suppressed his curiosity and forced himself to focus on completing his breakthrough first.
Yet just as he redirected his attention, another change began to unfold.
The Chaos Tree within his inner space suddenly trembled.
It was not a subtle movement.
The entire structure shook violently, as though responding to the transformation taking place within him. Before Max could fully comprehend what was happening, the tree began to grow.
Its size expanded rapidly.

What had once resembled a small plant rooted within his inner space now stretched upward, thickening and stabilizing as it transformed into a fully developed medium sized tree. Its presence became far more imposing, its branches spreading wider, its trunk growing denser, as though it had reached a new stage of life.
But the changes did not stop there.

As Max focused more closely, he noticed that each of the main branches of the Chaos Tree, which represented the core elements he had comprehended such as flame, lightning, ice, space, and others, began to shift.
From those primary branches, new branches started to emerge.
These were not random growths.

Each new branch extended from an existing one, as though it were a natural evolution of the original concept. The flame branch split further, giving rise to finer variations that carried subtle differences in heat and intensity.

The lightning branch extended into new paths, its energy becoming more intricate and layered. The ice branch expanded with additional offshoots that seemed to embody deeper aspects of cold and stillness.
The same phenomenon occurred across all the main branches.
One became many.
Each primary branch began to branch outward into countless possibilities, forming a complex and expanding network within the Chaos Tree.
Max’s eyes widened slightly as he took in the sight. He never thought even his Chaos Tree would undergo changes.

"It seems that the higher I ascend in cultivation, the more possibilities my abilities begin to reveal," Max murmured to himself as he steadied his thoughts. With that realization, he shifted his focus inward, directing his attention toward two of the most important branches within the Chaos Tree, the branches of flame and sword.

On the main flame branch, three Chaos Fruits hung quietly, each one radiating a faint yet profound aura. Originally, there had been five, but Max had already consumed one, while another remained stored within his dimensional space. Even so, the remaining fruits still carried immense significance, representing condensed manifestations of the flame laws he had comprehended.
However, what truly caught his attention was not the fruits themselves, but a smaller branch that extended from the main flame branch.

Unlike the main branch, which bore tangible fruits, this side branch appeared far more subtle. There were no fruits hanging from it. Instead, at its surface, Max could barely make out a faint, star shaped mark. The mark was so indistinct that it almost blended into the branch itself, and without complete focus, it would have been impossible to notice its existence.
Max narrowed his eyes slightly as he observed it more closely.
Then he shifted his gaze toward the sword branch.
There, he found a similar phenomenon.

A side branch extended outward, and upon it, there was also a star shaped mark. However, unlike the one on the flame branch, this mark was far clearer. It possessed a more defined structure, its outline sharper, as though it had already taken a more complete form.
Max fell into deep thought as he compared the two.
After a brief moment, realization struck him.
"Could these star shaped marks represent my cosmic paths?" he muttered softly.
The more he considered it, the more the idea made sense.

His comprehension of the sword path had always been far deeper than that of flames. He had invested more time, more effort, and more understanding into it, allowing it to develop far beyond the others. In contrast, his flame path was still in a much earlier stage, lacking the same depth and refinement.
This difference perfectly explained the disparity between the two marks.

The faint and almost invisible star on the flame branch reflected an incomplete and embryonic cosmic path, while the clearer mark on the sword branch represented a path that had already taken shape and gained substance.
Max’s expression grew serious as he understood the implication.
These were not just marks.
They were the foundations of something far greater.
"I am not sure whether these side branches serve any purpose beyond this," Max murmured softly, a hint of curiosity lingering in his voice as he observed the changes within his inner space.
At that very moment, a surge of power rose from within him.
His cultivation finally broke through.

The barrier that had held him at the peak of the Rebirth Realm shattered completely as his aura transformed, stabilizing at the first level of the Law Awakening Realm. The shift was profound, not just in strength but in essence, as his control over laws became clearer and more refined.
Max did not allow even a moment to pass.

Sensing the opportunity before him, he immediately reached into his dimensional space and took out several more corpses belonging to humans, primordials, and devils. Without hesitation, black flames surged from his body once again, engulfing the corpses and devouring them completely.
The energy they contained poured into him in rapid succession.

Each wave of devouring further strengthened his foundation, pushing his cultivation higher without pause. His aura continued to rise, breaking through one level after another as the accumulated power surged through his body.
In a short span of time, his cultivation advanced twice more.
By the time the last of the stored corpses had been completely consumed, Max’s strength had already reached the third level of the Law Awakening Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1560: Battle between Primordials and Devils!
paragraphs: "Reaching the third level of the Law Awakening Realm is a good outcome," Max murmured to himself, a faint sense of satisfaction settling within him as he stabilized his cultivation.
With that, he rose to his feet and returned to the group.

"The third level of the Law Awakening Realm?" Luna said, unable to hide her surprise as she looked at him closely. Advancing multiple levels in such a short span was something even she found difficult to comprehend.
Max gave a calm nod. "I still had some Divine Crystals left with me, so I made use of them while the opportunity was there."
"Then that is your good fortune," Luna replied, her tone steady as she accepted his explanation.
Max did not elaborate further. Instead, he simply said, "Let us continue."
The group resumed their journey toward the center of the secret domain, their pace steady as they moved deeper into the unknown.
Several hours passed.
Then, in the distance, a lone figure appeared.
It was a woman walking cautiously across the barren land, her silhouette becoming clearer as they approached.
"Lucia!" Isabella called out, her voice carrying across the silent battlefield.
Hearing her name, Lucia turned toward the sound. The moment she saw the group and recognized Max and Isabella among them, a wave of relief washed over her.

Ever since she had been dragged into this strange world, she had been forced to fight against those horrifying creatures repeatedly. With each battle, her concern for their safety had grown, fearing that they might have encountered the same danger.
Now, seeing them unharmed, she finally allowed herself to relax.
The group quickly reached her.
"Are you alright?" Max asked as he looked at her.
Lucia smiled faintly. "I should be the one asking you that. But since both of you seem fine, I have nothing to worry about either."
Max nodded in response. He then introduced Lucia to Luna and the others, briefly explaining their situation and their plan to head toward the center of the secret domain.
With Lucia joining them, the group continued forward once again.
However, not long after they resumed their journey, the atmosphere ahead began to change.
A distant rumble echoed across the land.
The ground trembled faintly beneath their feet, and an overwhelming pressure spread through the air.
Luna raised her hand immediately, signaling the group to stop.
"Do not move forward carelessly," she said in a low but commanding voice as she focused her senses ahead.
Max narrowed his eyes.
In the distance, a massive battlefield unfolded before them.
An army of devils clashed violently against an army of primordials.

The scale of the battle was beyond anything they had seen before. Countless figures collided in the sky and on the ground, their attacks tearing through space as waves of energy erupted in every direction.
Flames that burned like collapsing stars, lightning that split the sky apart, and spatial distortions that devoured entire sections of land appeared one after another.
Each strike carried enough power to annihilate everything in its path.

Mountains were shattered, the earth was ripped apart, and even the air seemed to distort under the intensity of their clash. The battlefield itself was being destroyed piece by piece, as though it could not withstand the sheer force of the war.
Max felt a heavy pressure settle on him as he observed the scene.
They could not get any closer.
Even from a distance, the residual shockwaves were enough to make their bodies tense. If they attempted to approach, they would be caught in the aftermath of those attacks and wiped out instantly.
Luna’s expression turned grave as she assessed the situation.
"We cannot go through this area," she said decisively. "Everyone, stay low and keep your auras suppressed. We will move along the edge and take a detour."
Her voice carried authority, and no one questioned her judgment.

"Follow my lead and do not act on your own," she continued as she began guiding the group along a safer path. "Keep your distance from the battlefield and remain alert. If any stray attacks come our way, defend only when necessary and do not counterattack recklessly."
Under her command, the group carefully adjusted their route, moving along the outskirts of the massive war zone.
Even then, the journey was far from easy.
Shockwaves from the distant battle occasionally reached them, forcing Luna to issue quick instructions.
"Move to the left. Keep your formation tight."
"Lower your presence. Do not draw attention."
"Watch the sky. Something is coming."
Each order came at the right moment, allowing the group to narrowly avoid the destructive aftermath of the battle.
As they continued their detour, the distant clash between the primordials and devils raged on, its scale and intensity leaving a deep impression on everyone present.
It was not just a battle.
It was a war capable of destroying an entire world.
Soon, they reached the other side of a massive mountain and stopped there to rest, using its towering presence as cover from the devastating clash between the armies of primordials and devils.
"What was that just now? Two entire armies fighting?" Max asked with a frown, deliberately acting as though he had no understanding of what they had witnessed.

Luna’s expression was dark, her eyes still reflecting the intensity of what lay beyond the mountain. "I recognized one of those armies," she said slowly. "If I am not mistaken, that force belongs to the primordials. I have seen them once before, and their aura is something I cannot forget."
Her voice grew heavier as she continued. "If that is true, then the other army can only belong to the devils. I believe I understand where we are now."
"Where?" Max asked, maintaining his act.

Luna looked at him, her gaze solemn. "I think we have somehow been sent back to the past, to the time when the war between the primordials and devils was taking place on Orion. That would explain the creatures we have encountered, and it would also explain why both of those forces are fighting here."
"But how can that even be possible?" Max asked, feigning disbelief. "How could we possibly travel back in time? Is something like that even real?"
Her words caused a ripple of shock to pass through the group. If what Luna said was true, then they had not merely entered a strange domain. They had stepped into a fragment of the past itself.
Before anyone could respond further, the ground suddenly trembled.
A violent force erupted from above.
A massive attack, unleashed from the distant battlefield, tore through the sky and crashed directly into the mountain they were hiding behind.
The impact was catastrophic.
The mountain shattered instantly.
Rocks and debris exploded outward as the entire structure collapsed, exposing their position in an instant. Dust and fragments filled the air, and the cover they had relied on was completely gone.
For a brief moment, silence fell.
Then—

chapters.title: Chapter 1561: Encountering a DEVIL!
paragraphs: "There are humans hiding here!"
A thunderous voice rang out from the battlefield.
"Kill them!"
The devils had seen them.
Max’s expression changed immediately. "Run!" he shouted without hesitation.
The group reacted at once, turning and fleeing as fast as they could. However, moving as a unit slowed them down, and their formation made it difficult to escape quickly.
Behind them, a terrifying presence surged forward.
The devils were already closing in.
Within moments, one of them appeared before the group, cutting off their path.
It was the first time they stood face to face with a true devil.

The creature towered over them, its body massive and grotesque, as though it had been forged from darkness itself. Its skin was a deep, unnatural black, yet faint crimson lines pulsed beneath it like veins filled with molten blood. Its limbs were long and distorted, ending in clawed hands that seemed capable of tearing through space itself.
Its face was even more horrifying.

A twisted, humanoid structure stretched into something inhuman, its mouth split wide into a permanent grin filled with sharp, uneven fangs. Its eyes burned with a sinister red glow, devoid of emotion, filled only with cold killing intent. Two red glowing horns atop their head making their face even more terrifying.
Around it, a suffocating aura spread.
The moment it appeared, the air grew heavy, pressing down on everyone like an invisible weight. It was not just power.
It was death.
A dense, oppressive energy radiated from the devil, carrying with it a sense of absolute destruction, as though anything standing before it would be erased without resistance.
The group froze for an instant.
This was no ordinary enemy.
This was a being that existed on an entirely different level.

Everyone froze the moment they saw the devil standing before them. Even though the aura it released was only at the peak of the Law Refinement Realm, the mere fact that they were facing a true devil sent a fear through them that they had never experienced before.
It was not just the pressure of strength. It was something deeper, something instinctive, as if their very existence was rejecting the presence of that being.
Only Max and Luna remained composed.

Max stood calm because the authority of his Primordial title naturally resisted the oppressive aura of the devil, washing away the pressure that would have otherwise weighed heavily on him. Luna, on the other hand, had been trained within the War God Palace to face life and death situations, and although her expression was serious, her mind remained steady.

’We have to deal with this quickly,’ Max thought, his mind moving rapidly as he extended his Dimensional Sovereign Body to scan the surroundings. Through it, he could already sense more devils approaching from behind. ’If we delay even for a moment, we will be completely surrounded.’
With that realization, Max made a swift decision.
"Everyone, be ready to run," he said sharply, his voice cutting through the tension.
As his words fell, Max finally drew out the Dragonheart, the legendary sword of the Sword Sovereign.
The moment the blade appeared, an overwhelming pressure spread through the surroundings.

"This sword..." Luna’s eyes widened as she recognized it instantly. Even without confirmation, the sheer aura emanating from the weapon made it clear that this was no ordinary blade. It was the Sword Sovereign’s weapon.
Max did not hesitate.
He unleashed the full power of his two thousand Draconic Essences.
In an instant, a violent surge of raw strength coursed through his body, his presence rising sharply as his power reached a new peak. Yet he continued further.
"Vein of Origin, open."
"Vein of Vitality, open."
With those words, two of his Seven Divine Veins were fully activated. Their power erupted without restraint, amplifying his already overwhelming strength to an even greater level.
A terrifying pressure burst outward from him.
The air trembled.

The ground beneath his feet cracked and collapsed, forming a shallow crater as the sheer force of his aura pressed down on everything around him. Even the members of his own group were forced to step back, unable to withstand the intensity of his presence.
This was merely the result of him releasing the full power of his two Divine Veins.
And yet, it was already enough to make the battlefield itself respond.

Luna’s eyes narrowed the moment she felt the violent surge of power rising from Max’s body. The intensity of that strength was beyond what she could easily comprehend. Even she, standing at the peak of the Law Refinement Realm, felt a trace of fear stir within her as she sensed the sheer force he was unleashing.
All of this happened within a single breath.
The devil had no time to react.

At that instant, Max’s gaze locked onto his target, his focus sharpening to an extreme degree as he activated the Black Dragon Inferno Furnace Art. Deep within his body, the twin lotus shaped cores ignited, blazing with immense energy.
As they burned, a new wave of power surged through him, amplifying his strength to a level far greater than anything he had displayed before.
Yet he did not stop there.
Max released his Concept of Severing Sword.
However, this was no longer a simple concept.
It had already begun to evolve into a half-baked cosmic path, and the moment he invoked it, that half formed path was triggered instinctively. The change was immediate and profound.
All emotions vanished from his mind.
The tension of the battlefield disappeared. The approaching devils no longer mattered. Even the danger surrounding his group faded into nothingness.
His thoughts stilled.
His mind entered a state of absolute calm or the right word would be a state of emotionless.
This was the true nature of his path. A path that severed everything, including fear, hesitation, and distraction.
"Thousand Star Severing," Max spoke softly, his voice devoid of emotion.
In the next instant, his body blurred into a streak of black light.
Before anyone could comprehend what had happened, Max had already moved past the devil and appeared behind it.
The devil remained frozen for a fraction of a second, its expression unchanged as if it had not yet understood what had just occurred.
Then—
A clean line appeared across its body.
In the next moment, its form split into two, the halves collapsing lifelessly onto the ground.
